name: Shopify (Graph QL)
shortInfo: Shopify is an ecommerce platform for online stores and retail point-of-sale systems.
brief: A single view of your online business, manage multiple sales channels, including web, mobile, social media, and marketplaces.
about:
The Shopify GraphQL Connector lets you sync data from Shopify GraphQL Admin API to your data warehouse automatically.

Check more about Shopify GraphQL API Documentation [here](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql).
availableData:
[Custom Query](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shopify-graphql/pipelines/custom-query.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data from Shopify store into your data warehouse.
